paper_scores.title: A Structured Analytical Review of Cyber-Physical Systems and Edge Computing Architectures for Soil Health Monitoring in Uganda: A Case Study of the Eastern Region Agricultural Sector
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns CPS/edge architectures and security for soil health monitoring in a specific agricultural setting. It shares general edge-computing concepts but not the landscape architecture 3D rendering problem or the same algorithms.

results.title: Machine learning-based e-commerce platform repurchase customer prediction model

paper_scores.title: Machine learning-based e-commerce platform repurchase customer prediction model
paper_scores.rationale: The claims closely mirror the retracted claims: e-commerce repurchase/customer demand prediction, XGBoost-logistic regression fusion, balanced P/N samples, SSP feature selection, SVM-based seasonal demand prediction, and customer segmentation.

paper_scores.title: Integrating Predictive Analytics with Customer Behavior Data in E-commerce Based on Machine Learning Model
paper_scores.rationale: It studies e-commerce customer behavior prediction, but the outcome is churn and the main method is CNN-BiLSTM with SMOTE rather than XGBoost-logistic fusion, SSP, or SVM demand modeling.

paper_scores.title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Customer Churn Risk in E-commerce
paper_scores.rationale: The paper is in e-commerce customer prediction and uses XGBoost and logistic regression within stacking, but the target is churn rather than repurchase or demand and it uses KS filtering/target encoding rather than the retracted SSP or P/N-sample framework.

paper_scores.title: Enhancing Customer Purchase Behavior Prediction Using PSO-Tuned Ensemble Machine Learning Models
paper_scores.rationale: It addresses e-commerce purchase behavior and includes XGBoost/boosting models compared with logistic regression, but its main contribution is PSO-tuned ensembles rather than the specific XGBoost-logistic hybrid or SSP approach.

paper_scores.title: An Integrated Machine Learning Model for E-Commerce Churn Prediction
paper_scores.rationale: It uses XGBoost with k-means segmentation in e-commerce, which is methodologically related to the retracted XGBoost and segmentation claims, but the outcome is churn rather than repurchase/customer demand.

paper_scores.title: Consumer Purchase Behavior Prediction on E-commerce Platforms Based on Machine Learning Fusion Algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: It targets e-commerce purchase behavior and uses a fusion model with logistic regression and SVM, which is close in spirit to the retracted hybrid predictive models, though it omits XGBoost and SSP feature selection.

paper_scores.title: Predicting Customer Lifetime Value Using Machine Learning Models: Evidence from Indian E-Commerce Firms
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses XGBoost and seasonal/customer behavior features in e-commerce, but predicts customer lifetime value rather than repurchase behavior or demand, making the solution related but the outcome different.

paper_scores.title: Integrated Machine Learning Approaches for E-commerce Customer Behavior Prediction
paper_scores.rationale: It addresses e-commerce customer behavior prediction and segmentation-related features, but relies mainly on Random Forest/Pipeline methods rather than the retracted hybrid XGBoost-logistic, SSP, or SVM demand models.

paper_scores.title: Enhancing e-Commerce Strategies: A Deep Learning Framework for Customer Behavior Prediction
paper_scores.rationale: It predicts e-commerce buying behavior, which is close to the retracted problem, but uses dense-layer deep learning and demographic data rather than the retracted XGBoost-logistic, SSP, or SVM approaches.

paper_scores.title: Research on Customer Value of E-commerce Data Based on Machine Learning
paper_scores.rationale: It includes logistic regression for e-commerce repurchase prediction and RFM/k-means customer segmentation, overlapping with the retracted repurchase and segmentation themes, but lacks the XGBoost-logistic hybrid and SSP methods.

paper_scores.title: Real-Time Dynamic Pricing Using Machine Learning: Integrating Customer Sentiment and Predictive Models for E-Commerce
paper_scores.rationale: It uses XGBoost in an e-commerce predictive framework, but the task is dynamic pricing and revenue optimization rather than customer repurchase, demand, churn, or segmentation.

paper_scores.title: E-Commerce Marketing Strategy Optimization Through Machine Learning-Based Conversion Prediction
paper_scores.rationale: It addresses e-commerce conversion/purchase prediction and segmentation, which is close to the retracted customer behavior problem, but uses k-means and Random Forest rather than the specific XGBoost-logistic, SSP, or SVM models.

paper_scores.title: Data Streaming Pipeline Model Using DBSTREAM-Based Online Machine Learning for E-Commerce User Segmentation
paper_scores.rationale: It concerns e-commerce user segmentation, related to one retracted segmentation claim, but its online DBSTREAM/HAC streaming clustering solution is materially different and it does not focus on predictive repurchase or demand performance.

paper_scores.title: E-commerce Customer Segmentation Using Machine Learning
paper_scores.rationale: It focuses on e-commerce customer segmentation using RFM-k-means, overlapping with the retracted segmentation theme, but it does not address high-frequency versus sparse users or the same predictive modeling setup.

paper_scores.title: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for E-Commerce Customer Churn Prediction Using SHAP
paper_scores.rationale: It uses XGBoost, logistic regression, and Random Forest in e-commerce customer prediction, but the target is churn and interpretability with SHAP rather than repurchase, SSP feature selection, or seasonal demand forecasting.

paper_scores.title: A Unified Model for Improving Recommendation System for Customer Reviews on E-Commerce Websites using Machine Learning Algorithms: Performance and Accuracy
paper_scores.rationale: It uses hybrid machine learning and includes XGBoost in e-commerce, but the main task is recommendation from reviews, cold-start, and sentiment analysis rather than customer repurchase or demand prediction.

paper_scores.title: Prediction of Customer Churn for an E- Commerce Company Using Machine Learning
paper_scores.rationale: It is an e-commerce/DTH churn prediction paper using bagging with logistic regression, related to customer retention modeling, but it does not use the retracted XGBoost-logistic fusion, SSP, or demand forecasting approaches.

paper_scores.title: Machine Learning–Based Consumer Behavior Prediction Models for E-Commerce Platforms: Enhancing Digital Financial Inclusion and Market Accessibility
paper_scores.rationale: The claims are broad statements about ML-based consumer behavior prediction, digital financial inclusion, and platform performance, with little overlap in specific outcomes or methods with the retracted claims.

paper_scores.title: The Role of Machine Learning in Enhancing the Customer Relationship of Indian E-commerce Sector
paper_scores.rationale: It discusses ML for customer relationships, personalization, NLP, and churn at a high level, but does not present the same specific e-commerce repurchase/demand prediction problems or the retracted hybrid methods.

paper_scores.title: Customer Churn Prediction on E-Commerce Using Machine Learning
paper_scores.rationale: It combines k-means segmentation, SVM prediction, and stacking with logistic regression for e-commerce churn, overlapping methodologically with the retracted segmentation/SVM/hybrid themes but targeting churn rather than repurchase or demand.

paper_scores.title: E-COMMERCE CUSTOMER BEHAVIOR USING MACHINE LEARNING
paper_scores.rationale: It broadly surveys e-commerce customer behavior prediction using decision trees, clustering, neural networks, and fMRI, but lacks the specific retracted tasks and methods beyond general customer-behavior ML overlap.

paper_scores.title: Knowledge Discovery on E-Commerce Customer Churn Using Interpretable Machine Learning: A Comparative Study of SHAP-Based Classifiers
paper_scores.rationale: It uses XGBoost/RF, SMOTE, and SHAP for e-commerce churn, sharing XGBoost and imbalance-handling themes, but the task is churn interpretability rather than repurchase prediction, SSP selection, or demand forecasting.

paper_scores.title: Prediction of Customer Behavior Changing via a Hybrid Approach
paper_scores.rationale: It uses a hybrid statistical/ML approach with customer segmentation and churn-related behavior prediction, related to the retracted customer segmentation and hybrid modeling ideas, but the MBG/NBD survival-threshold method is different.

paper_scores.title: Analisis Prediksi Customer Churn pada Sektor E-Commerce Berdasarkan Perilaku Transaksi Menggunakan Pendekatan Machine Learning
paper_scores.rationale: It applies Random Forest and logistic regression to e-commerce churn based on transaction behavior, but the outcome and main solution differ from the retracted repurchase/demand prediction and hybrid XGBoost/SSP methods.

paper_scores.title: Predicting consumer preferences for furniture products on E-commerce platforms: An analysis using machine learning and favorite listing data
paper_scores.rationale: It studies product preference prediction for furniture using Random Forest and Decision Tree, which is only broadly related to e-commerce behavior and does not match the retracted customer repurchase, segmentation, or demand tasks.

paper_scores.title: Prediction of financial customer buying behavior based on machine learning
paper_scores.rationale: It predicts online purchasing behavior using operation logs, feature engineering, logistic regression, and LightGBM, making the problem close but the solution only partly related to the retracted XGBoost-logistic and feature-selection claims.

paper_scores.title: Fake Product Review Detection in E-Commerce using Machine Learning
paper_scores.rationale: It uses a hybrid LSTM-XGBoost model in e-commerce, but for fake review detection, a substantially different task from customer repurchase behavior, demand prediction, or segmentation.

paper_scores.title: Product Return Prediction in E-Commerce Platforms
paper_scores.rationale: It applies hybrid DNN/GBM and behavioral features to product return prediction, sharing only broad e-commerce predictive modeling and gradient-boosting themes with the retracted claims.

paper_scores.title: E-commerce Product Price Forecasting using Machine Learning Algorithms
paper_scores.rationale: It uses XGBoost in e-commerce, but the task is product price forecasting and rule-based pricing recommendations, not customer repurchase, demand, or segmentation.

paper_scores.title: E-Commerce Website Sales Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: It addresses e-commerce sales/demand prediction, overlapping with the retracted demand forecasting claim, but uses Gradient Boosting and Random Forest rather than the retracted stable-volatility-plus-SVM model.

paper_scores.title: Transforming E-Commerce with Pragmatic Advertising Using Machine Learning Techniques
paper_scores.rationale: It concerns ML for advertising optimization, reinforcement learning, and dynamic ad personalization, which is only broadly related to e-commerce customer behavior and lacks the retracted specific problems and methods.

results.title: Single image super-resolution via Image Quality Assessment-Guided Deep Learning Network

paper_scores.title: Single image super-resolution via Image Quality Assessment-Guided Deep Learning Network
paper_scores.rationale: The claims directly match the retracted paper: IQA-guided SISR, cascaded IQA supervision of SR loss, pairwise ranking hinge loss, perceptual-distortion tradeoff, and flexible architecture.

paper_scores.title: A No-Reference Deep Learning Quality Assessment Method for Super-Resolution Images Based on Frequency Maps
paper_scores.rationale: This paper focuses on no-reference quality assessment of super-resolution images using frequency maps and a two-stream ResNet, not on IQA-guided SISR training. It shares the SR-IQA context but applies it to assessment rather than reconstruction.

paper_scores.title: Quality assessment of models and deep learning methods for super-resolution image formation
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses SISR model evaluation and quality metrics, including perceptual measures and overfitting concerns, but uses comparative evaluation and pre-trained model analysis rather than IQA-supervised SR training.

paper_scores.title: Enhanced Deep Residual Networks for Single Image Super-Resolution
paper_scores.rationale: This is a core SISR deep-learning paper, but its solution is residual network architecture optimization, multi-scale SR, residual scaling, and L1 loss, not IQA-guided loss construction or ranking-based label generation.

paper_scores.title: Single Image Super-Resolution with Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: The paper surveys deep-learning SISR methods such as SRCNN, EDSR, RCAN, graph networks, and Transformers. It shares the SISR problem but not the specific IQA-guided cascaded training solution.

paper_scores.title: Image Super-Resolution Using Deep Convolutional Networks
paper_scores.rationale: SRCNN addresses the same SISR task with deep CNNs, but the method is direct end-to-end LR-to-HR mapping rather than IQA-guided optimization, cascaded supervision, or pairwise ranking hinge loss.

paper_scores.title: A Systematic Survey of Deep Learning-Based Single-Image Super-Resolution
paper_scores.rationale: The survey covers the same broad SISR field, including loss functions, perceptual quality, efficient designs, and assessment methods, but does not present the same IQA-guided cascaded SR method.

paper_scores.title: Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution Using Feature Grouped Multi-Scale Network
paper_scores.rationale: The paper performs image super-resolution in remote sensing using grouped multi-scale, edge-enhancement, attention, and arbitrary-scale modules. It shares broad SR goals but differs in domain and lacks IQA-guided training.

paper_scores.title: Dual Path Attention and Re-parameterization Network for efficient image super-resolution
paper_scores.rationale: This paper addresses SISR and balances reconstruction quality with efficiency, but it uses dual-path attention, re-parameterization, distillation, and multi-loss fine-tuning rather than an IQA network supervising SR.

paper_scores.title: Multi-prior physics-enhanced neural network enables pixel super-resolution and twin-image-free phase retrieval from single-shot hologram
paper_scores.rationale: The work concerns holographic microscopy phase retrieval and pixel super-resolution using physics-enhanced priors, a substantially different imaging problem and solution from natural-image IQA-guided SISR.

paper_scores.title: Advancing 1.5T MR imaging: toward achieving 3T quality through deep learning super-resolution techniques
paper_scores.rationale: The paper applies deep-learning super-resolution to MRI harmonization using a transformer-enhanced GAN and a custom quality metric. It shares SR and quality-evaluation themes but differs in medical setting and method.

paper_scores.title: Enhancing Image Quality via Deep Autoencoder Architectures for Single Image Super-Resolution
paper_scores.rationale: This paper addresses SISR with a deep convolutional autoencoder, skip connections, residual learning, and MSE loss. It shares the task but uses a meaningfully different reconstruction architecture and training objective.

paper_scores.title: Ultra Sharp : Study of Single Image Super Resolution Using Residual Dense Network
paper_scores.rationale: The paper studies SISR using residual dense networks, dense feature fusion, and residual learning. The problem overlaps, but the solution is architectural feature reuse rather than IQA-guided loss supervision.

paper_scores.title: Research on high-quality image super-resolution reconstruction algorithm based on deep convolutional generative adversarial network
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns high-quality SR, especially for 3D-MRI, using DCGAN/ESRGAN variants, perceptual/adversarial/content losses, and self-similarity. It shares perceptual-quality SR aims but not the IQA-guided cascaded training mechanism.

paper_scores.title: Super-resolution single-molecule reconstruction of composite infrared images based on deep machine learning
paper_scores.rationale: The paper applies improved SRGAN-style super-resolution to infrared composite-material images using residual dense blocks, SE attention, and batch-normalization removal. It is related by SR but differs in domain and core method.

paper_scores.title: Enhancing Single-Image Super-Resolution using Patch-Mosaic Data Augmentation on Lightweight Bimodal Network
paper_scores.rationale: This paper addresses SISR with Patch-Mosaic augmentation and a lightweight CNN/Transformer bimodal network. It shares the same task but not IQA-guided supervision or pairwise ranking hinge labeling.

paper_scores.title: Optimized highway deep learning network for fast single image super-resolution reconstruction
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses SISR using highway connections and gating to improve training stability and efficiency. It overlaps in task and deep-learning setting, but the technical solution differs from IQA-supervised cascaded training.

paper_scores.title: Learning-Based Quality Assessment for Image Super-Resolution
paper_scores.rationale: This work builds an SR quality database and a deep IQA model for super-resolution images. It is close to the IQA component of the retracted paper, but its main problem is quality prediction, not using IQA to train an SR network.

paper_scores.title: A Two-Branch Multiscale Residual Attention Network for Single Image Super-Resolution in Remote Sensing Imagery
paper_scores.rationale: The paper performs SISR in remote sensing imagery using a two-branch multiscale residual attention network. It shares SR reconstruction and quality-performance goals, but the domain and method differ substantially.

paper_scores.title: Cartoon single-image super-resolution approach based on generative adversarial network
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses cartoon SISR using a GAN-based transfer-learning model with batch-normalization removal and VGG features. It shares SISR and perceptual-quality concerns but not IQA-guided SR optimization.

paper_scores.title: Image quality assessment for determining efficacy and limitations of Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Network (SRCNN)
paper_scores.rationale: This paper uses IQA metrics to evaluate SRCNN efficacy and limitations. It combines SISR and quality assessment, but only for evaluation, not as an integrated IQA network supervising SR training.

paper_scores.title: A Cosine Network for Image Super-Resolution
paper_scores.rationale: The paper proposes CSRNet for SISR using heterogeneous convolutional blocks, residual learning, and cosine annealing. It addresses the same SISR task but uses a different architecture and optimization strategy.

paper_scores.title: Hand-drawn Illustration Design in National Wave Style Based on Deep Learning and Image Super Resolution Reconstruction
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses GAN/ESRGAN-based super-resolution for hand-drawn illustration generation and style preservation. It shares broad SR and perceptual-quality goals but is a different creative-application problem and solution.

paper_scores.rationale: The claims closely mirror the retracted work: dynamic export-sales prediction for cross-border e-commerce/foreign trade using controllable big data, distributed quantitative and centralized qualitative calculations, intelligent prediction, inventory/marketing uses, and superior forecast accuracy.

paper_scores.title: Strengthening International Trade Finance Operations: Strategies for Preventing Trade-Based Money Laundering (TBML)

paper_scores.title: Empirical analysis of integrated teaching mode of international trade based on practical training data detection and neural network
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns blended/MOOC-based international trade education and student outcomes, not export sales prediction or cross-border e-commerce goods classification.

paper_scores.title: THE ROLE OF BIG TECH IN INTERNATIONAL TRADE: PLATFORMS AS FACILITATORS OF CROSS-BORDER E-COMMERCE
paper_scores.rationale: The paper shares the cross-border e-commerce setting and mentions AI-driven inventory and demand forecasting, but its main focus is platform market power, trade frictions, and regulation rather than a specific dynamic export-sales prediction model.

paper_scores.title: Blockchain Technology and the Digitalization of Trade Finance: A Theoretical Analysis of Letter of Credit Process Efficiency and Cost Reduction
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses blockchain-based letter-of-credit processing in trade finance, not forecasting export sales or clustering cross-border e-commerce goods.

paper_scores.title: Embedded neuromorphic attention model leveraging a novel low-power heterogeneous platform
paper_scores.rationale: The work focuses on neuromorphic visual attention and embedded event-camera processing, unrelated to international trade sales forecasting.

paper_scores.title: DEPLOYING CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORK MODELS ON UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLES ON-BOARD COMPUTER
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns optimizing CNNs for UAV edge deployment, a different task and method context from export sales prediction in cross-border e-commerce.

paper_scores.title: Analysis on "Internet + consumer finance" Based on E-Commerce Platform
paper_scores.rationale: Although it shares e-commerce and an Internet-plus framing, the paper is about consumer finance access and risk management, not export sales forecasting or goods clustering.

paper_scores.title: Customs Efficiency and Logistics Performance in Azerbaijan: Implications for International Trade Development
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses customs/logistics modernization in Azerbaijan. Its fuzzy logic and hybrid optimization language has only weak methodological resemblance to uncertainty handling in the retracted prediction model.

paper_scores.title: Artificial Intelligence in FinTech and Its Implications for International Trade Efficiency
paper_scores.rationale: The paper discusses AI and predictive analytics in trade finance efficiency, risk, fraud, and compliance. It is adjacent to international trade finance but does not address export goods sales forecasting; AI overlap is broad.

paper_scores.title: Digital Trade and the International Division of Labor: A Literature Review and Analytical Framework from a Global Value Chain Perspective
paper_scores.rationale: The paper shares a broad digital trade/platform context but studies global value chains, specialization, and governance rather than predicting export sales or classifying goods.

paper_scores.title: Application of Neural Network to Predict Rupiah Exchange Rate Against Korean Won

paper_scores.title: Output Spillovers from U.S. Monetary Policy: The Role of International Trade and Financial Linkages
paper_scores.rationale: The paper models macroeconomic spillovers from U.S. monetary policy through trade linkages, not product-level export sales forecasting or e-commerce data mining.

paper_scores.title: AI-Driven Risk Scoring Model for Global Cross-Border Trade Payment Transactions
paper_scores.rationale: The supplied claims concern feminist discourse in Hindi literature, which is unrelated to the retracted paper despite the source title.

paper_scores.title: Model of the “Economic Cross” of the Digital Platform: Opportunities and Conditions for Interindustry Technological Convergence
paper_scores.rationale: The single claim concerns a conceptual digital-platform economic model for interindustry convergence, not export sales prediction or related data-mining methods.

paper_scores.title: Research On Supply Chain Based on Medical Informatics and E-Commerce System: Computer Engineering and Algorithm to Prevent Disease
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses neural-network prediction and supply-chain concepts, but for disease, radiation, medical trade, and drug-purchase willingness rather than export goods sales.

paper_scores.title: Application Research on International Trade Information Management System Oriented On Service
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses international trade operations, inventory, export management, and decision support, but its solution is an ASP.NET/B/S information management system rather than a dynamic predictive analytics model.

paper_scores.title: Dynamic Hand Gesture Recognition for Human–Computer Interaction
paper_scores.rationale: The paper focuses on gesture recognition using MediaPipe, GRU, attention, and quantization, with no substantive connection to export sales prediction.

paper_scores.title: Business Communication as a Driver of Value in Entrepreneurial, Trade, and Logistics Ecosystems: Innovations, Sustainability, and Digital Ethics
paper_scores.rationale: The claims concern business communication, digital ethics, ESG, and communication tools in trade/logistics ecosystems, not forecasting export goods sales.

paper_scores.title: Building an International Talent Pipeline: A Vocational College's International Collaboration Model for Agricultural Cooperation
paper_scores.rationale: The paper is about vocational education and agricultural cooperation with Russia, not cross-border e-commerce sales prediction or clustering.

paper_scores.title: Quantum Economics: Reframing Value, Scarcity, and Exchange in the Digital Age

paper_scores.title: Application and Development of Electronic Commerce in International Trade in Our Country

paper_scores.title: A Scalable Platform for Distributed Object Tracking Across a Many-Camera Network

paper_scores.title: Analysis of influencing factors of regional import and export trade based on an artificial neural network

paper_scores.title: Vision Transformers on the Edge: A Comprehensive Survey of Model Compression and Acceleration Strategies

paper_scores.title: The Impact of the Development Trend and Policy Optimi-zation of NEV on Guizhou Consumers' Usage Behavior Based on Its Natural Environment
paper_scores.rationale: The supplied claims address Hong Kong financing and trade support for mainland SMEs, not export-sales forecasting methods or cross-border e-commerce goods classification.

paper_scores.title: Speech Recognition Systems Using Deep Learning Accuracy vs. Efficiency Trade-offs
paper_scores.rationale: The paper discusses ASR architectures and efficiency trade-offs, which are not closely related to the retracted paper's trade sales prediction framework.

paper_scores.title: From Prediction to Decision: A Survey of Machine Learning Applications in Quantitative Finance
paper_scores.rationale: The paper surveys machine-learning forecasting and decision models in quantitative finance. It shares a general financial prediction/ML theme but addresses market prediction and trading rather than export-goods sales.

paper_scores.title: Decentralized Finance (DeFi): Disrupting Traditional Banking Systems and Their Regulatory Challenges
paper_scores.rationale: The paper focuses on DeFi, blockchain finance, and regulation, not cross-border e-commerce export sales prediction.

paper_scores.title: FinTech 4.0 and the Future of Global Finance: Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence, and Big Data as Catalysts of Digital Financial Innovation
paper_scores.rationale: The paper covers AI, big data, and blockchain in global finance, including credit scoring and fraud detection. The overlap is only broad use of intelligent/big-data methods, not the same trade sales forecasting problem.

paper_scores.title: Application and Practice of Student-Centered Blended Teaching in the International Settlement Course
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns blended teaching for trade finance education and professional competency development, not export sales prediction.

paper_scores.title: Quantized neural network for complex hologram generation
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses quantized neural networks for hologram generation on embedded systems, which is unrelated to international trade or sales forecasting.

results.title: Research on multi-objective optimal scheduling considering the balance of labor workload distribution

paper_scores.title: Research on multi-objective optimal scheduling considering the balance of labor workload distribution
paper_scores.rationale: The claims closely match the retracted paper: same parallel flow shop scheduling problem, same objectives of delay and employee workload balance, and the same NSGA-II-EDSP, NSGA-II-KES, and NSGA-II-QKES solution variants.

paper_scores.title: Research on optimal scheduling of integrated energy system based on improved multi-objective artificial hummingbird algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: This is a multi-objective optimization study with Pareto-solution claims, but it addresses low-carbon integrated energy dispatch using an artificial hummingbird algorithm, not employee-balanced parallel flow shop scheduling or NSGA-II variants.

paper_scores.title: Multi-objective Demand Side Management in Distribution Networks with Renewable Generation
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns demand-side management in power distribution networks with renewable uncertainty and grid stability metrics, sharing only broad multi-objective scheduling language with the retracted work.

paper_scores.title: A Multi-Objective Clustered Input Oriented Salp Swarm Algorithm in Cloud Computing
paper_scores.rationale: It uses a multi-objective metaheuristic and clustering for cloud resource allocation, but the scientific problem, setting, objectives, and algorithm differ substantially from flow shop scheduling with NSGA-II variants.

paper_scores.title: Multi-Objective Optimization for Load Balancing and Trading Scheduling in Networked Microgrids
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses Pareto-based multi-objective optimization for microgrid load balancing and trading with MOPSO, but it does not address flow shop employee workload scheduling or use the retracted NSGA-II methods.

paper_scores.title: A Bioinspired Method for Optimal Task Scheduling in Fog-Cloud Environment
paper_scores.rationale: This is another multi-objective task scheduling metaheuristic, but the fog-cloud setting, objectives, and CLARO algorithm are meaningfully different from manufacturing flow shop scheduling and NSGA-II-QKES.

paper_scores.title: GA-PSO-MIN: A HYBRID HEURISTIC ALGORITHM FOR MULTI-OBJECTIVE JOB SCHEDULING IN CLOUD COMPUTING
paper_scores.rationale: The paper applies a GA-based hybrid heuristic with initial scheduling rules to a different cloud job scheduling problem, giving some solution-family similarity but not the same flow shop workload-balancing problem.

paper_scores.title: MULTI-OBJECTIVE-OPTIMIZATION APPROACH FOR OPTIMAL TASK SCHEDUL-ING THROUGH IN DELAY SENSITIVE CLOUD ENVIRONMENT
paper_scores.rationale: It optimizes cloud task scheduling and workload balance using a CHHO metaheuristic, but the setting and solution are different from employee-balanced parallel flow shop scheduling with improved NSGA-II.

paper_scores.title: Shift Scheduling in Healthcare: Considering Legal Regulations and Workload Fairness for Radiology Technicians
paper_scores.rationale: The paper shares workforce scheduling, workload fairness, and mathematical programming elements, but the healthcare shift scheduling setting, legal constraints, and absence of NSGA-II make it only moderately related.

paper_scores.title: A MULTI-OBJECTIVE OPTIMIZATION APPROACH TO LOAD BALANCING AND TASK SCHEDULING IN IOT-FOG-CLOUD NETWORKS
paper_scores.rationale: The claims involve multi-objective task scheduling and load balancing, but for IoT-fog-cloud systems using Horse Herd Optimization rather than flow shop employee workload scheduling.

paper_scores.title: Multi-Objective Fuzzy Optimization for Energy, Carbon, and SLA Efficiency in Cloud Computing
paper_scores.rationale: The hybrid GA-based optimization has limited solution-family overlap with evolutionary scheduling methods, but the problem is cloud VM placement and energy-carbon-SLA tradeoffs, not parallel flow shop workload balancing.

paper_scores.title: Dynamic economic emission dispatch of combined heat and power system based on multi-objective differential evolution algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: The improved differential evolution algorithm uses non-dominated sorting, crowding distance, elite populations, and Pareto metrics similar to evolutionary multi-objective methods, but the dispatch problem is unrelated to flow shop employee scheduling.

paper_scores.title: Research on Multi-Objective Hybrid Flow Shop Scheduling Problem With Dual Resource Constraints Using Improved Memetic Algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: This is strongly related at the problem level: multi-objective flow shop scheduling with worker constraints, tardiness, and workload balance. However, it uses an improved memetic algorithm rather than the retracted NSGA-II-EDSP/KES/QKES methods.

paper_scores.title: Multi-objective Nurse Scheduling Models with Patient Workload and Nurse Preferences
paper_scores.rationale: The paper shares multi-objective integer scheduling and workload/satisfaction concerns, but it addresses nurse scheduling with patient workload and goal programming, not manufacturing flow shop scheduling or NSGA-II heuristics.

paper_scores.title: Multi-Objective Squirrel Search Algorithm for Multi-Area Economic Environmental Dispatch With Multiple Fuels and Valve Point Effects
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses Pareto dominance, crowding, and multi-objective performance indicators, but applies them to power-system economic environmental dispatch with a squirrel search algorithm, a different problem and method.

paper_scores.title: Exploration of Human–Robot Collaborative Two-Sided Assembly Line Optimization Based on Workload Balancing
paper_scores.rationale: It shares manufacturing optimization and explicit human workload balance objectives, but the task is human-robot two-sided assembly line balancing and the algorithm is multi-objective MBO, not parallel flow shop scheduling with NSGA-II variants.

paper_scores.title: MOM-VMP: multi-objective mayfly optimization algorithm for VM placement supported by principal component analysis (PCA) in cloud data center

paper_scores.rationale: This paper is about Indonesian text sentiment analysis using BERT-CNN variants, with a different modality, task, outcome, and model context from commodity image recognition.

paper_scores.title: A Deep Learning Approach for Fault Diagnosis in Centrifugal Pumps through Wavelet Coherent Analysis and S-Transform Scalograms with CNN-KAN
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses CNN-based feature extraction from time-frequency scalograms for pump fault diagnosis, a different engineering signal-diagnosis problem; overlap with the retracted work is limited to CNN-based classification and robustness language.

paper_scores.title: Artificial intelligence algorithms for object detection and recognition in video and images
paper_scores.rationale: The work addresses image/object recognition and compares against VGG models, using a CNN-ResNet50 hybrid rather than MS-CNN. It is related at the task and method level but not commodity-specific and lacks the same label-error/SNR robustness setup.

paper_scores.title: Real-Time Image Recognition and Video Analysis Using Deep Learning for Aurangabad Smart City
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses MTCNN, a cascaded convolutional architecture related to multi-stage CNNs, but applies it to face detection/alignment and YOLOv3 vehicle collision detection in smart-city video, not commodity recognition.

paper_scores.title: A Comprehensive Review of Artificial Intelligence Techniques for Black Pepper and Spice Identification Using Computer Vision and Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: Spice identification is close to commodity/product image identification, but the paper emphasizes ViT, MobileNet, SqueezeNet, hyperspectral/multispectral imaging, and review-level barriers rather than the same MS-CNN platform and robustness experiments.

paper_scores.title: An Intelligent Mobile Application to Automate the Analysis of Food Calorie using Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: The paper performs food image classification in a mobile app, which is related to product/commodity recognition, but it uses MobileNet for calorie-related food categories with much lower reported accuracy and different goals from MS-CNN commodity robustness.

paper_scores.title: Artificial intelligence for early endometrial cancer diagnosis using multimodal clinical data: integrating deep learning, explainability, and data privacy
paper_scores.rationale: This paper concerns multimodal endometrial cancer diagnosis with histopathology, clinical data, explainability, and privacy-aware learning, sharing only broad deep-learning image-analysis concepts with the retracted commodity-recognition work.

results.title: Analysis of the pattern recognition algorithm of broadband satellite modulation signal under deformable convolutional neural networks

paper_scores.title: Analysis of the pattern recognition algorithm of broadband satellite modulation signal under deformable convolutional neural networks
paper_scores.rationale: The source paper matches the retracted work almost exactly: broadband satellite modulation recognition using deformable CNNs, constellation-map T1/T2 features, ReLU/MBGD/Softmax configuration, data-length effects, and comparison against VGG/AlexNet/ResNet.

paper_scores.title: Approach to processing radio signals with amplitude modulation of many components using one-dimensional convolutional neural network
paper_scores.rationale: This paper also concerns noisy radio-signal recognition and modulation-related processing using CNNs, but it addresses many-component amplitude-modulated radio signals with 1D CNN/recurrent processing rather than broadband satellite modulation recognition with deformable CNNs and constellation T1/T2 features.

paper_scores.title: Modulation Recognition and Classification using DBRNN and CNN Modules
paper_scores.rationale: The scientific task is strongly related—automatic modulation recognition under varying and low SNR—but the method is meaningfully different, using DBRNN denoising, autoencoder reconstruction, and CNN classification on RadioML data rather than deformable CNNs for broadband satellite modulation patterns.

paper_scores.title: Machine Learning using Graph Neural Networks for Star Identification in Celestial Navigation
paper_scores.rationale: This paper addresses star identification for celestial navigation using graph neural networks and synthetic star-field imagery, which is neither the same modulation-recognition problem nor the same deformable-CNN satellite-signal solution.

paper_scores.title: Joint Optical Performance Monitoring and Modulation Format/Bit-Rate Identification by CNN-Based Multi-Task Learning
paper_scores.rationale: The paper overlaps in modulation-format identification and CNN-based signal-image analysis, but the setting is heterogeneous optical networks with delay-tap phase portraits and multi-task optical performance monitoring, not broadband satellite modulation recognition using deformable CNNs.

paper_scores.title: 6G-AUTOR: Autonomic CSI-Free Transceiver via Realtime On-Device Signal Analytics
paper_scores.rationale: Only part of the paper overlaps through automatic modulation classification and deep-learning signal recognition using a 1D CNN; the overall work is a broader 6G autonomic transceiver framework with spectrum management, beamforming, decoding, and CSI-free operation, not the same satellite modulation-recognition study.

results.title: Multi-script handwritten digit recognition using multi-task learning

paper_scores.title: Real-Time Handwritten Digit, Character and Mathematical Symbol Recognition Using Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses handwritten digit/character recognition, but uses conventional CNN, preprocessing, feedback, and ensemble/similarity methods rather than multi-task learning or script-classification auxiliary tasks.

paper_scores.title: RETRACTED: Multi-script handwritten digit recognition using multi-task learning
paper_scores.rationale: This is the retracted paper itself and restates the same multi-script handwritten digit recognition problem, multi-task learning solution, four-class auxiliary reformulation, loss-weight avoidance, and Amharic extension.

paper_scores.title: Discrete wavelet transform and convolutional neural network based handwritten Sanskrit character recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Concerns handwritten Indic-script character recognition, but the problem is single-script Sanskrit characters and the method is DWT/CNN/GoogLeNet rather than multi-task learning.

paper_scores.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition Using Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: Shares the handwritten digit classification setting, but focuses on standard MNIST CNN training and preprocessing, not multi-script recognition or MTL auxiliary tasks.

paper_scores.title: Performance Analysis of Few-Shot Learning Approaches for Bangla Handwritten Character and Digit Recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Studies handwritten Bangla character/digit recognition and cross-lingual generalization, but uses few-shot/prototypical hybrid networks rather than the retracted MTL formulation.

paper_scores.title: Handwritten Recognition of Telugu Characters Using Various Pretrained Convolutional Neural Networks
paper_scores.rationale: Related only at the broad level of handwritten script recognition; it evaluates pretrained CNNs for Telugu vowels, not multi-script digit recognition or MTL.

paper_scores.title: A Transformer-Based Optical Character Recognition Framework with Unified Residual Recurrent Networks for Multilingual Handwritten Documents
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses multilingual handwritten OCR, which is related to multi-script recognition, but the task is document/text OCR and the solution is Transformer/URRNN/CTC rather than MTL with auxiliary script tasks.

paper_scores.title: Incremental Recognition of Multi-Style Tibetan Character Based on Transfer Learning
paper_scores.rationale: Strongly related in addressing adaptation across script styles with shared features and style classifiers, but it uses transfer learning for Tibetan character styles rather than the retracted MTL loss-control approach for multi-script digits.

paper_scores.title: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Handwritten Character Recognition Using the EMNIST Dataset
paper_scores.rationale: Covers handwritten character recognition with CNN/MLP/residual comparisons on EMNIST, but lacks multi-script digit recognition and multi-task auxiliary learning.

paper_scores.title: End-to-End Historical Handwritten Ethiopic Text Recognition Using Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: Shares an Ethiopic/Amharic-related handwritten recognition setting, but targets historical text transcription using CNN-BiLSTM-attention-CTC rather than MTL for character or digit classification.

paper_scores.title: Integrated Convolutional Neural Network and Genetic Algorithm Based Technique for Emnist Handwritten Character Recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Related only as handwritten character recognition; the solution is CNN with genetic feature optimization, not multi-task learning or multi-script digit classification.

paper_scores.title: A Lightweight CNN for Multi-Class Classification of Handwritten Digits and Mathematical Symbols
paper_scores.rationale: Includes handwritten digit classification, but the task combines digits and mathematical symbols using a lightweight CNN, with no multi-script setting or MTL auxiliary-task mechanism.

paper_scores.title: APPLICATION OF NEURAL NETWORKS FOR AUTOMATED TEXT AND SYMBOL RECOGNITION IN CYBERSECURITY TASKS
paper_scores.rationale: Only broadly related through OCR/character recognition; it addresses noisy cybersecurity text images using CNN-RNN-CTC, not multi-script handwritten digit recognition or MTL.

paper_scores.title: Joint Classification and Trajectory Regression of Online Handwriting using a Multi-Task Learning Approach
paper_scores.rationale: Uses multi-task learning in handwriting, but for online handwriting classification plus trajectory regression with different losses, not offline multi-script digit recognition with script-classification auxiliaries.

paper_scores.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition using Machine and Deep Learning Algorithms
paper_scores.rationale: Shares handwritten digit recognition, but compares SVM, MLP, and CNN on MNIST rather than multi-script recognition or any MTL framework.

paper_scores.title: Fast, Simple and Accurate Handwritten Digit Classification by Training Shallow Neural Network Classifiers with the ‘Extreme Learning Machine’ Algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses handwritten digit classification, but the solution is shallow ELM variants for MNIST, meaningfully different from multi-task learning with auxiliary script tasks.

paper_scores.title: Handwritten Digits Recognition Using Neural Network
paper_scores.rationale: Concerns handwritten digit recognition and CNN preprocessing/segmentation, but not multi-script digit recognition and not the MTL loss-regularization approach.

paper_scores.title: ADOCRNet: A Deep Learning OCR for Arabic Documents Recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Related as handwritten/printed script OCR, but it focuses on Arabic document sequence recognition with CNN-BLSTM-CTC and augmentation, not MTL for multi-script digits.

paper_scores.title: Performance Comparison of Machine Learning Models for Handwritten Devanagari Numerals Classification
paper_scores.rationale: Close in recognizing handwritten numerals from a non-Latin script, but it is single-script Devanagari numeral classification using CNN and model comparison, not multi-task learning.

paper_scores.title: Multi-column deep neural networks for image classification
paper_scores.rationale: Includes handwritten digit/character benchmarks and improved classification accuracy, but uses multi-column DNN ensembles rather than MTL with script auxiliary classification.

paper_scores.title: Comparison of convolutional neural network and bag of features for multi-font digit recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses digit recognition under font variation, somewhat analogous to script/style variation, but uses CNN and BoF/SVM rather than multi-task learning.

paper_scores.title: Transformer Framework with Dynamic Learning Rate Optimisation for Offline Devanagari Character Recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Related to offline handwritten Indic character recognition, but uses a Transformer/CNN/BiLSTM/CTC framework for Devanagari characters, not MTL or digit/script auxiliary tasks.

paper_scores.title: Multi-Digit Handwritten Sindhi Numerals Recognition using SOM Neural Network
paper_scores.rationale: Shares handwritten numeral recognition in a non-Latin script, but the task is Sindhi multi-digit pairs and the method is SOM, not multi-script MTL.

paper_scores.title: Handwritten Amharic Character Recognition Using a Convolutional Neural Network
paper_scores.rationale: Strongly overlaps the retracted Amharic claim: it uses MTL based on Amharic alphabet row/column structure to improve character recognition, though its main task is Amharic characters rather than multi-script digits.

paper_scores.title: Construction of a neural network for handwritten digits recognition based on TensorFlow library applying an error backpropagation algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: Shares the general handwritten digit recognition task, but uses a basic fully connected TensorFlow network with backpropagation on MNIST, not multi-script MTL.

paper_scores.title: An efficient CNN model with squirrel optimizer for handwritten digit recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses handwritten digit recognition and performance improvement, but through LCNN with squirrel optimization rather than auxiliary-task MTL or multi-script modeling.

paper_scores.title: Multi-Dimension Geospatial Feature Learning for Urban Region Function Recognition
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns urban region function recognition from geospatial and remote sensing data, with no substantive overlap in problem, data setting, or method with handwritten multi-script MTL recognition.

paper_scores.title: Comparative Analysis of the Application of Multilayer and Convolutional Neural Networks for Recognition of Handwritten Letters of the Azerbaijani Alphabet
paper_scores.rationale: Related only through single-script handwritten character recognition; it compares LeNet-style CNNs, MLPs, and handcrafted features rather than MTL.

paper_scores.title: Character Recognition Of Seventeenth-Century Spanish American Notary Records Using Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: Broadly related to handwritten character recognition, but the problem is historical Spanish American notarial scripts and the method is pretrained CNN classification, not multi-script digit MTL.

paper_scores.title: Multi-Domain Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Ancient Urdu Text Recognition System
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses ancient Urdu ligature/text recognition with a multi-domain CNN, which is only broadly related to handwritten/script recognition and not to MTL for digits.

paper_scores.title: GradientBased Learning Applied to Document Recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Covers foundational CNN/LeNet handwritten digit and document recognition, sharing the general digit-recognition outcome but not the multi-script MTL auxiliary-task solution.

paper_scores.title: Domain Adversarial Neural Networks for Dysarthric Speech Recognition
paper_scores.rationale: Uses domain adaptation and compares MTL-like models, but the application is dysarthric speech recognition, not handwritten character or digit recognition.

paper_scores.title: Multi-Lingual Optical Character Recognition System Using the Reinforcement Learning of Character Segmenter
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses mixed-script multilingual OCR, close to the multi-script recognition setting, but uses reinforcement-learning segmentation, a switcher, and language-specific recognizers rather than MTL auxiliary script classification.

paper_scores.title: Improving the Eastern Arabic Hand Written Digits Recognition Using Deep Learning
paper_scores.rationale: Shares handwritten digit recognition for a non-Latin numeral set, but uses a modified LeNet-5 model rather than multi-task learning or multi-script auxiliary tasks.

results.title: Big data tracking and automatic measurement technology for unmanned aerial vehicle trajectory based on MEMS sensor

paper_scores.title: Big data tracking and automatic measurement technology for unmanned aerial vehicle trajectory based on MEMS sensor
paper_scores.rationale: This is essentially the same UAV trajectory tracking and automatic measurement problem using MEMS sensors, iterative learning control, discrete quadratic error compensation, and quaternion fusion of gyroscope, accelerometer, and magnetometer data.

paper_scores.title: Using big data to address global environmental challenges
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns environmental and biodiversity monitoring with heterogeneous data, FAIR workflows, cloud computing, remote sensing, and AI. It does not address UAV trajectory measurement or use the MEMS, ILC, Kalman/quaternion, or gradient-descent trajectory-tracking approach.

paper_scores.title: Determining the trend of geometrical changes of a hydrotechnical object based on data in the form of LiDAR point clouds
paper_scores.rationale: The paper studies geometric change detection in hydrotechnical structures using LiDAR point clouds, normal vectors, clustering, and least-squares plane fitting. The object, task, and methods differ substantially from MEMS-based UAV trajectory tracking.

paper_scores.title: IMPROVING THE ACCURACY OF UAV MODULE MOTION CONTROL USING INERTIAL SYSTEMS WITH HOMOGENEOUS SENSORS
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses closely related UAV motion or trajectory tracking accuracy using MEMS inertial sensors and Kalman filtering, overlapping with part of the retracted method. However, it uses homogeneous accelerometers and noise reduction rather than the full ILC, quaternion gyroscope-accelerometer-magnetometer fusion, disturbance compensation, and gradient-descent framework.

paper_scores.title: Vision based Automatic line inspection Quadrotor Aircraft
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses UAV/quadrotor trajectory tracking for line inspection, which is related to UAV trajectory control, but it uses a meaningfully different vision-based pipeline with HSI binarization, median filtering, PID control, PIXHAWK, and Raspberry Pi rather than MEMS sensor fusion, ILC, Kalman disturbance estimation, quaternion equations, or gradient descent.

results.title: A full freedom pose measurement method for industrial robot based on reinforcement learning algorithm

paper_scores.title: A full freedom pose measurement method for industrial robot based on reinforcement learning algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: The claim matches the retracted work's core problem and solution: full-freedom industrial robot pose measurement using multi-agent reinforcement learning combined with PSO, with the same stated accuracy and efficiency improvements.

paper_scores.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Smooth Guidance of a Free-Floating Robot in Point-to-Point Tasks
paper_scores.rationale: This paper concerns full-pose control of a free-floating manipulator using deep reinforcement learning, not industrial robot pose measurement with multi-agent RL plus PSO. The overlap is mainly robotic pose handling and RL-based control.

paper_scores.title: Inverse kinematic solution and singularity avoidance using a deep deterministic policy gradient approach
paper_scores.rationale: The paper uses a reinforcement-learning method for robotic manipulator inverse kinematics and singularity avoidance, but it does not address full-freedom industrial robot pose measurement or use PSO-enhanced multi-agent Q-learning.

paper_scores.title: Control Barrier Functions for Safe Real-Time Control of Spacecraft Onboard Robotic Manipulators
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses safe real-time control of spacecraft manipulators using control barrier functions and DRL. It shares some RL-based robotic full-pose control themes, but the setting, safety-filter method, and objective differ from industrial pose measurement with PSO-QL.

paper_scores.title: Modeling and analysis of forward and inverse kinematics for a flexible Stewart platform
paper_scores.rationale: This work addresses pose prediction, kinematics, and positioning accuracy for a flexible Stewart platform, using piezoelectric compensation and an LM-improved BP neural network. It is related to pose accuracy but differs in object, setting, and solution.

paper_scores.title: A Low-Cost, Modular, Cable-Driven, Anthropomorphic Robotic Hand: A Conceptual Design and Application in Biomimetic Study
paper_scores.rationale: The paper is mainly about robotic hand design and biomimetic teleoperation. One claim uses deep reinforcement learning for pose replication, but the problem and solution are largely distinct from industrial robot pose measurement with PSO-enhanced multi-agent RL.

paper_scores.title: A new efficient pose estimation and tracking method for personal devices: application to interaction in smart spaces
paper_scores.rationale: This paper addresses six-degree-of-freedom pose estimation and real-time tracking, but for personal devices in smart spaces using cameras, accelerometers, and colored markers rather than industrial robots and reinforcement learning with PSO.

paper_scores.title: A Systems Engineering Approach to Robotic Bin Picking
paper_scores.rationale: The paper concerns robotic bin picking with 3D pose estimation of objects in cluttered scenes, which is relevant to industrial robotic manipulation. However, it uses depth sensing, segmentation, geometric matching, and PCA rather than multi-agent RL with PSO for robot pose measurement.

results.title: Machine learning based identification and classification of disorders in human knee joint – computational approach

paper_scores.title: Machine learning based identification and classification of disorders in human knee joint – computational approach
paper_scores.rationale: The source paper's claims closely match the retracted claims: VAG-based knee joint disorder detection using GSBFS feature selection with mutual information and dichotomous logit regression combined with radial kernelized least-square SVM classification, reporting improved accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and time complexity. It does not present a meaningfully different solution or apply the same solution to a different problem.

results.title: Multivariate weighted isotonic regressive modest adaptive boosting-based resource-aware routing in WSN

paper_scores.title: Multivariate weighted isotonic regressive modest adaptive boosting-based resource-aware routing in WSN
paper_scores.rationale: The source paper matches the retracted claim directly: it addresses resource-aware routing in wireless sensor networks using the same MWIRMAB-RAR approach, combining Modest Adaptive Boosting with multivariate weighted isotonic regression to select nodes by energy and bandwidth, using time-of-flight for multipath routing, and reporting reduced energy use, packet loss, and delay with improved delivery.

results.title: Dispatching and rebalancing for ride-sharing autonomous mobility-on-demand systems based on a fuzzy multi-criteria approach

paper_scores.title: Dispatching and rebalancing for ride-sharing autonomous mobility-on-demand systems based on a fuzzy multi-criteria approach
paper_scores.rationale: The source paper's claims closely match the retracted claims: both address dispatching and rebalancing in RAMoD systems, customer preference integration, uncertain demand and costs, and objectives of minimizing lost requests, reducing costs, and improving satisfaction. The methods are also the same or nearly identical, including fuzzy MCDM, fuzzy AHP, fuzzy TOPSIS, and multi-objective possibilistic linear programming. There is no meaningful different solution or different problem represented.

results.title: Fault location measurement of sensor nodes based on fuzzy control algorithm

paper_scores.title: Fault location measurement of sensor nodes based on fuzzy control algorithm
paper_scores.rationale: The claims directly match the retracted paper: WSN sensor-node fault location using fuzzy-control clustering, cluster-head measurement, RBF neural-network symptom processing, and the same performance outcomes.

paper_scores.title: Energy Efficient Multimedia Transmission in Wireless Sensor Networks using Enhanced Adaptive Transmission Control Algorithm and Measurement Techniques
paper_scores.rationale: This paper concerns multimedia transmission, routing, latency, security, and QoS rather than fault location. It only weakly overlaps through WSN clustering and fuzzy route prioritization.

paper_scores.title: Enhanced Fuzzy Clustering Approach Using Moth flame Optimization Algorithm for Efficient Data Aggregation in Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: The problem is energy-efficient data aggregation, routing, and congestion control, not fault location. The overlap is limited to fuzzy clustering and cluster-head optimization in WSNs.

paper_scores.title: Fuzzy logic Based Seagull Optimization Algorithm for Efficiency and Security in Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: This work addresses energy-efficient and secure clustering/routing, not fault diagnosis or fault-location measurement. It has moderate method overlap through fuzzy cluster-head selection using energy, distance, and node-density factors.

paper_scores.title: A novel competitive cuckoo search algorithm for node placement in wireless sensor networks
paper_scores.rationale: The main task is node placement and energy-aware clustering, not fault location. Fuzzy C-means clustering gives only weak solution-level similarity.

paper_scores.title: A Fuzzy Multi-Objective Framework for Energy Optimization and Reliable Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks via Particle Swarm Optimization
paper_scores.rationale: The paper focuses on energy optimization and reliable routing with fuzzy PSO, not fault-location measurement. The only overlap is broad fuzzy optimization in WSNs.

paper_scores.title: Fuzzy based energy efficient cluster head selection with balanced clusters formation in wireless sensor networks
paper_scores.rationale: Although the problem is energy-efficient balanced clustering rather than fault location, the method closely overlaps in fuzzy cluster-head selection using residual energy and node centrality.

paper_scores.title: EWFAIGF: Design of an Efficient Model for Enhancing Energy Efficiency in IoT-Based Wireless Sensor Networks through Fuzzy AHP and Iterative Grey Wolf Jelly Fish Optimization
paper_scores.rationale: The work is primarily about energy-efficient clustering and routing; its fault-tolerant routing aspect is related but not the same as sensor fault-location diagnosis. Fuzzy clustering gives weak method overlap.

paper_scores.title: A Novel Congestion Control Scheme using Firefly Algorithm Optimized Fuzzy-PID Controller in Wireless Sensor Network
paper_scores.rationale: This paper addresses congestion control using a Firefly-optimized Fuzzy-PID controller, not fault location. The overlap is limited to fuzzy-control ideas in WSNs.

paper_scores.title: DEAR-SFCM: Dynamic Energy Aware Radius Adaptive Subtractive Fuzzy C-Means Clustering Framework for Efficient and Sustainable Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: The paper targets energy-balanced fuzzy clustering and network lifetime, not fault location. It shares fuzzy clustering and cluster-head selection concepts but not the diagnostic/RBF components.

paper_scores.title: Development of the method for increasing the accuracy of localization of wireless sensor networks
paper_scores.rationale: It concerns WSN node localization accuracy and energy reduction, which is only loosely related to fault-location measurement. The method is different and does not use fuzzy clustering or RBF diagnosis.

paper_scores.title: Mobile Anchor Assisted Effective Node Localization Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: This is physical node localization using mobile anchors, RSS, and trilateration, not sensor fault-location diagnosis. It shares only the broad WSN localization setting.

paper_scores.title: A fuzzy/possibility approach for area coverage in wireless sensor networks
paper_scores.rationale: The problem is area coverage and node sleep scheduling, not fault location. There is some method overlap through fuzzy/possibilistic cluster-head selection using energy and distance criteria.

paper_scores.title: Energy-aware and Context-aware Fault Detection Framework for Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: This paper addresses WSN sensor fault detection/classification with energy-aware clustering, making the problem closely related. However, it uses Extra-Trees and EE-FLACH rather than the retracted paper's fuzzy-control fault-location method with RBF neural networks.

paper_scores.title: Coyote Optimization Based on a Fuzzy Logic Algorithm for Energy-Efficiency in Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: The task is energy-efficient clustering, not fault-location measurement. The solution is fairly similar in fuzzy cluster-head selection using residual energy, distance, and neighboring-node information.

paper_scores.title: An Energy Efficient Routing Protocol Based on Improved Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: This paper focuses on energy-efficient routing and clustering, not fault location. It overlaps only through fuzzy C-means-based clustering and cluster-head optimization in WSNs.

paper_scores.title: Color-Theory-Based Geographical Energy-Efficient Routing Featuring Fuzzy Logical Control for Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: The problem is energy-efficient geographic routing, not fault localization. The fuzzy cluster-head selection variables—remaining energy, neighboring nodes, and distance—are closely related to part of the retracted solution.

paper_scores.title: A Method for Fault Tolerant Localization of Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: This paper is related through fault-tolerant localization in WSNs and improving localization accuracy under faulty references, but it uses normalized distance estimates and Jenks Natural Breaks rather than fuzzy clustering or RBF neural diagnosis.

paper_scores.title: Coverage Control Algorithm-Based Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization and Node Sleeping in Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks
paper_scores.rationale: The work addresses 3D coverage control and node sleeping in multimedia sensor networks using adaptive PSO, with no substantive overlap in fault-location problem or fuzzy/RBF diagnostic solution.

paper_scores.title: Game theory based adaptive transmit power control algorithm for IoT wireless sensor networks
paper_scores.rationale: This paper concerns adaptive transmit-power control using game theory for throughput, connectivity, and energy cost, not fault location or fuzzy/RBF clustering-based diagnosis.

results.title: Cardiac arrhythmia detection using dual-tree wavelet transform and convolutional neural network

paper_scores.title: Cardiac arrhythmia detection using dual-tree wavelet transform and convolutional neural network
paper_scores.rationale: Direct match: ECG cardiac arrhythmia detection using DTWT feature extraction and CNN classification, including AF, MI, and BBB outcomes.

paper_scores.title: Accurate Cardiac Arrhythmia Detection Using Horse Herd Optimization Algorithm-Enhanced Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN-HOA)
paper_scores.rationale: Same ECG arrhythmia classification setting with CNNs and wavelet preprocessing, but uses db6 denoising and Horse Herd Optimization rather than DTWT feature extraction.

paper_scores.title: A Novel Inter Patient ECG Arrhythmia Classification Approach with Deep Feature Extraction and 1D Convolutional Neural Network
paper_scores.rationale: Same ECG arrhythmia classification problem and combines wavelet-derived features with a 1D CNN, but uses Wavelet Scattering Transform and SMOTE rather than DTWT.

paper_scores.title: A Dual-Channel Pine Wilt Disease Recognition Method with Discrete Wavelet Transform
paper_scores.rationale: Uses a related wavelet-plus-CNN feature fusion strategy, but the task is UAV image object detection for pine wilt disease, not ECG arrhythmia or cardiac diagnosis.

paper_scores.title: Automatic detection and classification of cardiac arrhythmia using neural network
paper_scores.rationale: Strong overlap in ECG arrhythmia classification and DTCWT/DWT feature extraction, though the classifier is a general neural network rather than a CNN.

paper_scores.title: Attention-Enhanced Convolutional Neural Network for Inter-patient Classification of Premature Ventricular Contraction from ECG
paper_scores.rationale: Addresses ECG arrhythmia detection with wavelet decomposition and CNNs, but focuses specifically on PVC detection and adds dual-path attention and segmentation methods instead of DTWT.

paper_scores.title: Automatic Detection of Atrial Fibrillation Based on Continuous Wavelet Transform and 2D Convolutional Neural Networks
paper_scores.rationale: Same ECG-based arrhythmia domain and uses wavelet time-frequency representations with CNN classification, but targets AF episodes specifically and uses CWT rather than DTWT.

paper_scores.title: CNN Based ECG Dual Heart Beat Arrhythmia Detection
paper_scores.rationale: Same ECG arrhythmia classification problem and CNN-based classification, but the solution is dual-heartbeat coupling matrices without wavelet or DTWT feature extraction.

paper_scores.title: SAR ship target detection method based on CNN structure with wavelet and attention mechanism
paper_scores.rationale: Uses a closely related DTCWT-plus-CNN architecture, but applies it to SAR ship target detection and speckle reduction rather than ECG cardiac arrhythmia diagnosis.

paper_scores.title: Electrocardiogram Based Arrhythmia Classification Using Long Short-Term Memory with Luong Attention Mechanism
paper_scores.rationale: Same ECG arrhythmia classification setting and MIT-BIH use, but the core solution is CWT preprocessing with LSTM and Luong attention rather than DTWT with CNN.

paper_scores.title: Hybird RNN based feature extraction for early prediction of CVDs using ECG Signals for type 2 diabetic patients
paper_scores.rationale: Overlaps in ECG-based cardiac disease detection and DTCWT-based preprocessing/features, but focuses on CVD prediction in type-2 diabetic patients using hybrid RNN/Adaboost rather than CNN arrhythmia classification.

results.title: Securing medical data by role-based user policy with partially homomorphic encryption in AWS cloud

paper_scores.title: Securing medical data by role-based user policy with partially homomorphic encryption in AWS cloud
paper_scores.rationale: The claims directly match the retracted paper: the same SPHE algorithm, medical-data outsourcing problem, AWS deployment, role-based policy, probabilistic prime/modular design, and performance comparison against Elgamal, Paillier, and Benaloh.

paper_scores.title: Hierarchical Role-Based Access Control with Homomorphic Encryption for Database as a Service
paper_scores.rationale: This paper also combines role-based access control with partial homomorphic encryption for outsourced cloud/database confidentiality, but it targets generic multi-tenant DBaaS, uses Paillier and hierarchical/session mechanisms, and lacks the medical-data, AWS, SPHE, and multiplication/division-specific elements.

paper_scores.title: An Efficient Multi-User Groupwise Integrity CP-ABE(GI-CPABE) for Homogeneous and Heterogeneous Cloud Blockchain Transactions
paper_scores.rationale: The paper addresses a very similar medical cloud data security and access-control problem, but its solution is GI-CPABE with blockchain, hashing, compression, and attribute/group policies rather than SPHE, AWS deployment, or homomorphic multiplication/division.

paper_scores.title: Secure Phrase Search for Intelligent Processing of Encrypted Data in Cloud-Based IoT
paper_scores.rationale: The paper shares the broad area of encrypted cloud data and uses homomorphic/probabilistic cryptographic techniques, but its task is privacy-preserving phrase search in cloud IoT, not medical-data outsourcing, role-based AWS access control, or SPHE arithmetic operations.

paper_scores.title: A New Authentication and Homomorphic Encryption as a Service Model for Preserving Privacy in Clouds
paper_scores.rationale: This paper overlaps on securing medical data in cloud settings and enabling computations over encrypted data using homomorphic encryption, but it proposes an A-HEaaS authentication/service architecture with key-management separation and 2FA rather than the retracted paper's SPHE algorithm, AWS S3/Elastic Beanstalk model, and role-based medical access policy.

results.title: Hybrid high performance intelligent computing approach of CACNN and RNN for skin cancer image grading

paper_scores.title: Hybrid high performance intelligent computing approach of CACNN and RNN for skin cancer image grading
